description: YHPUgrout-2103 Polyurethane Injection Resin is a single-component, low-viscosity, water-reactive injection resin.
whereToUse: For the sealing of leakage in residential and commercial buildings
underground tunnels, subway tunnels, highway tunnels
water conservancy and hydropower projects, mining projects
for improving the impermeability of the soil surface layer
advantages: Low viscosity, good injectability, and excellent adhesion to the substrate.
Foams and expands rapidly when in contact with water, with a high expansion multiple.
During free foaming, an expansion multiple of about 15 times can generally be achieved.
In the sealant, a high-strength rigid closed-cell foam is formed.
The injection resin is resistant to most organic solvents, weak acids, alkalis, and organic microorganisms.
It is packaged in a single-component form, ready to use, and the construction is simple and convenient.
notFor: Construction should be carried out under well-ventilated conditions, and construction workers should take appropriate safety-protection measures.
Avoid contact of this product with skin.
Use the product as soon as possible after opening.
Do not add any diluent to this product under any circumstances.

technicalData.label: Shelf life
technicalData.value: 9 months from the date of production

storage: The storage temperature should not exceed 40°C.
